results.correct_value: Running water is normally available at the ~5,800 ft Terror Basin camp; in heavy-snow years it may need a short search.
results.evidence: One report describes the flat gravelly ~5,800 ft camp as having running water; a range overview calls it an easy water source; another party in a snowy early season had to search and found a trickle a few hundred feet below camp. The waypoint note is supported; the dispute sits in bivy[0].water, which is not patched here.

Net elevation difference trailhead (~600 ft) to camp (~5,800 ft) is about 5,200 ft, matching the approach and itinerary, but a recorded GPS track gives about 5,835 ft of cumulative ascent to Terror Basin camp and one report says roughly 4,000 ft; reaching Crescent Creek Basin via the 6,200 ft notch adds more. No two sources agree on a figure that makes '6,000+' clearly wrong.
